Commentary.Commentary: With 451 runs on board, Virat Kohli's men would have to put together a brilliant batting performance to make a statement. A good opening stand is very crucial. The batsmen have too little time to rest and they have to be mentally strong and not lose a single wicket till tea. The visitors on the other side would want to take a wicket or two. Let's see who manages to prevail.

India were made to toil for almost 138 overs but finally they have managed to bowl Australia out for 451. The visiting side was in a spot of bother on 140/4 at one stage. But amidst the storm, Steven Smith and Glenn Maxwell stood in India's way as they scored centuries. The former remained not out on 178. The pick of the bowlers for India was Ravindra Jadeja who bowled almost 50 overs and sent five Australian batsmen back to the hut.

OUT! Outstanding stuff from Jadeja to run out Hazlewood. Full floated ball on middle, Smith works it behind square leg and wants the second run. Hazlewood responds and rushes to his end. Meanwhile, Rahul collects the ball, fires in the throw at the non-striker's end and Jadeja collects it well ahead of the stumps. Now comes the magical part. Sir just back flicks the ball behind and scores the bull's eye. Hazlewood is found short of the crease in the replays and AUSTRALIA ARE ALL OUT FOR 451!
The umpires have gone upstairs for a run out of Josh Hazlewood who seems to be in trouble.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bowls it down the leg side, Smith paddles sweep it to long leg.
India are not happy with the ball as its seam has got ripped and they want to change it. The umpire obliges and they have got another cherry.
A low full toss on middle, JH jams it out towards the leg side.
Sprays it on the pads, Josh looks to flick but it hits his pads.
Full length delivery, around off, Smith looks to drive but it takes the inside edge and goes onto hit the pads. The ball goes towards the cover region and the batsmen run through for a single.
Bowls it very full and on middle, Smith makes room and drives it to the mid off region.
Fullish delivery outside off, Smith drives it towards covers. He denies a single though.
Full length delivery outside off,  Smith looks to cut but misses.
Josh Hazlewood is the last man in.
Time for drinks.

OUT! Eighth fifer for Jadeja. He has been persistent throughout the day and he has got his rewards. Tossed up delivery outside off, Lyon prods forward to defend, but the ball bounces more than Lyon would've expected. Due to which the ball hits the upper half of the bat and goes straight to Karun Nair at silly point who crouched low, kept his eyes on the ball and grabbed it sharply.
Floats this one around middle, flicked away through mid-wicket for one run.
Smith tries to play the reverse sweep but finds the backward point fielder.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Lyon looks to defend but it takes the leading edge and goes past first slip for one run.
Jadeja goes over the wicket and bowls it around off, Lyon goes forward to defend.
Pitches it outside leg, from around the wicket, Smith flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on.
Fullish delivery which comes back in, Lyon stands in his crease to block it firmly.
Full delivery around off, Lyon blocks it towards the off side.
What has happened there? Umesh Yadav's front foot gets stuck in the ground while he was in his run-up and falls. Fortunately, he's fine.
Sprays it down the leg side, Lyon looks to flick but it is out of his reach.
Nathan Lyon is the new man in.

OUT! Change of boots does the trick? Don't know but India would take the wickets in any manner. Short delivery, chest height, Steve O'Keefe swivels across and pulls it straight to Murali Vijay at fine leg who gets low to cup it. India break the frustrating partnership.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Steve gets across and blocks it with a straight face of the bat.
Length delivery outside off, Smith pushes it towards covers. One run added to the total.
Meanwhile, Umesh Yadav has changed his boots.
Tosses this one around off, Steve goes forward to defend but misses and the ball hits his pads. India appeal but it is turned down, probably there was an inside edge.
50-run stand comes up between Steven Smith and Steve O'Keefe.
Shortish delivery, outside off, Smith cuts it through point for a single.
Full and around off, Steve eases it towards mid off for a single.
Flatter delivery on middle, SOK defends it towards the on side.
Looped up delivery outside off, Steve drives it to covers.
A silly mid on has been placed.
Bowls it slower through the air around middle and leg, Smith clips it towards mid-wicket and beats Rahul who was fielding in that position. They run a single.
Short of a length delivery, SOK gets on his back foot and punches it to covers.
Straigter delivery which stays low, Steve gets his bat down in time and deviates it towards mid-wicket.
Bowls a full inswinging delivery, Steve stands in his crease and knocks it firmly down the ground.
Length ball, which nips back in, O'Keefe stonewalls it.
Similar length outside off, Smith opens the face of the bat and pats it through point. Single taken.
Fullish delivery outside off, Smith drives it to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tosses it around off, SOK defends it with an angled bat towards the on side.
Fuller delivery and on middle, Smith drives it through mid on for a single.
Flatter delivery, Smith tucks it towards the leg side.
Drags his length back and keeps it outside off, Smith goes back and cuts it towards covers.
Bowls it slower through the air and on middle, Smith clips it away to mid-wicket.
Ravichandran Ashwin replaces Ravindra Jadeja and comes into the attack.

FOUR! Short ball which has been put away. Steve waited in his crease and just pulled away fine. There were two deep fielders present but to no avail. Australia closing in on 450. Steve is also batting on his highest Test score now.
Good length delivery around middle, O'Keefe puts it away towards the same area.
Fullish delivery, Steve comes across and flicks towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller length delivery which comes back in, SOK gets inside the line of the delivery and nudges it towards the leg side.
Good length delivery outside off, Smith drives it towards the short cover fielder who misfields. The Australian captain sees that and asks Steve to come for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Smith looks to cut but it takes the inside edge and goes towards the keeper.
Another forward defense by O'Keefe to end the over.
Quicker and fuller on off, defended off the front foot.
Flighted and wide outside off, an easy leave for Steve.
Loopy full ball on off, O'Keefe defends it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller delivery around off, Smith defends it towards the off side and steals a quick single.
Shortish delivery, Steve guides it down to third man and runs one.
Back of a length delivery, around off, Steve goes on his back foot to defend.
Fullish delivery again, Smith drills it through covers for a single.
Fuller delivery which nips back in, Smith tries to flick but it goes off the inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Umesh Yadav comes back into the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up around off, Steve has blocked it.
FOUR! Beautiful stroke. Marginally short and outside off, SOK goes back and cuts it past point for a boundary.
SOK opens the face of the bat and pats this floated delivery towards point.
Floats this one outside off, SOK is rock solid in defense.
Tosses this one outside off, Smith pushes it to mid off and sets off for a quick single.
Steve prods forward and buries it onto the ground.
O'Keefe leans forward and dead-bats this tossed up delivery.

FOUR! Tosses this one outside off, Steve gets back to block but the ball beats him and Saha and rolls away for some extras. There wasn't any edge, however the umpire thought otherwise and decided to give the runs to Steve.
Floats this one outside off, SOK goes ahead to defend but the ball spins back in and he gets rapped on the pads. A stifled appeal is turned down.
SOK defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Smith eases this floated delivery through mid on and runs one.
Steve buries this tossed up delivery onto the ground.

Appeal for an LBW. Turned down! O'Keefe leans forward to defend this tossed up delivery but it takes the inside edge and goes onto hit the pads. Jadeja goes up in an appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Smith flicks this tossed up delivery towards mid-wicket for a single.
Smith has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Hits the rough outside leg and ball spins away sharply as Saha collects it.
Pitches it outside leg, Smith makes room and drives it to covers.
A lot fuller and around off, Steve leans and pushes it towards the bowler.
Loops this one around middle, O'Keefe pushes it towards the leg side.
Ashwin bowls a flatter delivery, SOK defends it towards the off side.
FOUR! Floats this on middle, slightly slower, SOK remains in his crease and chooses the safest area of the ground. Whacks it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Tossed up around middle, Steve flicks it to mid-wicket.
Fires this down the leg side, Smith uses his feet and whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Drags his length back, Steve goes back and blocks it.
Floats this one on leg, Steve uses his pads to keep it out.
Similar delivery by Jadeja, SOK uses the same approach and offers no shot.
Floats this one around leg and the ball nips back in, SOK pads it away. Jadeja appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
Pitches it outside leg, Smith clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Bowls it very full, Smith goes ahead a touch and flicks it against the spin to deep mid-wicket. The deep fielder chased it but to no avail.
Tossed up outside off, SOK drives it to mid off.
Steve has driven this looped up delivery towards the mid-on region.
Floats this one around, Steve knocks it down the ground.
SOK drives this tossed up delivery to mid on.
FOUR! Lucky! Floats this one around off, Steve goes back and forth and cuts it. The ball came off the outside edge and lobs over Rahane at first slip and goes for a boundary to the third man fence.
Tossed up around middle, SOK defends it.
Bowls this around middle and leg, Smith works it around towards the leg side.
Gives this one a lot of flight and bowls it on middle, Steve goes ahead to defend but it takes the outside edge and flies past first slip. They run a single.
Flatter and quicker, SOK bunts it back to the bowler.
Floated delivery outside off, SOK strides forward and drives it to mid off.
Lands this on the rough outside leg, Smith goes back and punches it towards mid-wicket where Pujara makes a mess out of an easy stop. Smith takes advantage of that and takes a single.
Tosses this one around leg, Smith opens up and defends it towards the off side.
O'Keefe dances down the track and dead-bats this floated delivery.
Flatter and on the sticks, SOK defends it.
Steve reaches out to the pitch of this looped up delivery and buries it.
Quicker and flatter on the sticks, Smith defends it towards mid on and runs one.
Floats this one around off, Smith has blocked it.
Tosses this one outside off, Smith looks to cut it but misses.
Tossed up outside off, Steve drives it down the ground.
Very full delivery and on the sticks, O'Keefe is rock solid in defense.
Floats this one around leg, SOK goes forward and stonewalls it.
Full delivery on middle, Steve knocks it towards mid off.
Bowls in the same area, Smith makes room and drives it towards mid off for a run.
Tosses this one outside leg, Smith clears his front leg and defends.
Pitches it full and on off, spinning back in a bit, O'Keefe defends it back.
Leans forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Full and around off, O'Keefe defends off his front foot to the off side.
Flighted and outside off, defended towards the point region.
Loopy and full around off, Smith eases it down to long on for a run.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Welcome back. The players are on the field. It's going to be Ravichandran Ashwin to continue proceedings...
...DAY 2, SESSION 2...

Steven Smith continues to hold one end tightly and has crossed the 150-run mark. He has not been troubled even a single bit and is looking well set for a double hundred. However, he is quickly running out of partners. Australia already have 401 runs on the board and will look to add as many runs as possible in the next session. With the pitch starting to take spin, India will be concerned as Australia also have a couple of excellent spinners in their ranks. Join us in a short while for more action.

Fabulous session for Australia! They once again scored in excess of 100 but lost three wickets as well. Glenn Maxwell was the first batsman to depart soon after reaching his maiden Test hundred and then after batting with positive intent, Matthew Wade also got out. Pat Cummins didn't last long and became the fourth victim of Ravindra Jadeja. The left-arm spinner was the best bowler on show for India as the rest struggled to leave any impact.
Flighted delivery landing outside leg, Steve offers no shot and pads it away. A desperate appeal from the Indian players but nothing from the umpire. Lunch on day 2!
O'Keefe has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.o run.
Prods forward and drives it down the ground for a single at long off.
Fires a full ball on the pads, Smith eases it through square leg for a couple of runs. 400 up for Australia!
Sharp spin from around middle and leg, Smith pushes at it and gets a soft outside leg. Doesn't carry to Rahane at first slip.

Sixth 150-plus score in Tests for Smith! He raises his bat towards the Australian dressing room and David Warner is standing there clapping. Full and around off, Smith pushes it with gentle hands to point for a run.
Gets on the front foot and drives it back to the bowler.
Strides forward and defends it with soft hands to backward point for a run.
Shortish and around off, O'Keefe tries to cut but misses.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, worked off the pads to the leg side.
Steve O'Keefe is the new batsman.

OUT! Right through the gate! The crowd erupts in joy as Sir Jadeja gets rid of another batsman. Bowls it flatter through the air and pitches it on middle and leg. Cummins gets forward to defend but it spins away, beats the outside edge and shatters the stumps. What a terrific delivery to the new batsman. Cummins falls for a duck.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pat Cummins is the new batsman. He is quite handy with the bat and is known to use the long handle well.

OUT! Jadeja strikes again and he removes the dangerous looking Wade. Hurls a full ball outside off, 91 kph, turning in just a shade, Wade draws forward to defend, probably expecting it to turn a lot. But the ball skids through, take a faint outside edge and Saha grabs another sharp catch behind the stumps. End of a handy knock by the Australian wicketkeeper batsman.
Tossed up ball landing around leg and spinning away, Smith stays back and pushes it with the turn to cover-point for a run.
Too full and just outside off, Wade connects with his sweep shot and sends it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted ball landing outside off, Wade tries to sweep but misses. Saha is quick to take the bails off but Wade never left his crease.
Quicker ball around leg, Smith whips it off his pads but finds the square leg fielder.
Loopy and around off, Smith walks forward and defends it back.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Allows the ball to spin back in from outside off and works it through mid-wicket for a run. Jadeja gives the chase and they decide not to take risk for the second run.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, Wade walks forward and pushes it off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Flighted full ball on off, Wade defends it to the off side.

Uppish but safe! Sharp spin back into the batsman from around off, Wade tries to defend but it catches the inside edge and flies past short leg. Karun Nair sticks his right hand out but the ball has already gone past him. A single taken.
FOUR! Wade is really leaving a mark here, trying to dominate the Indian spinners. Fetches a full ball from outside off and sweeps it in front of square leg for a cracking boundary.
Flatter and shorter on off, Wade punches it to mid off.
Tossed up ball around leg, Smith goes back and turns it to the left side of Rahul at short fine leg. He makes a tumbling stop and they cross for a run.
Once again the leg stump line by Jadeja, Smith defends it by covering the line.
Flighted ball outside leg, Smith offers no shot and pads it away.
Identical to the last delivery, once again Wade keeps it out safely.
Fuller and on middle and leg, Wade defends it back off his front foot.
FOUR! Excellent footwork by Wade again. He shimmies down the track to take it on the full and eases it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted off spinner landing full on middle and off, Wade lunges and defends it back.
Fuller and quicker on middle, Smith clips it through backward square leg for a run.
Flighted full ball on middle, Smith defends it off his pads to mid-wicket.
50-run stand between Steven Smith and Matthew Wade.
On the pads again, helped in the gap at backward square leg for a single.
Pushes it quicker and flatter on middle, Smith works it off his pads to the leg side.
This one turns square from the rough, Smith plays inside the line from the crease and gets beaten.
Lands a full ball outside leg, Smith pads it away.
Quicker and fuller outside off, Wade pushes it through covers and crosses for a run.
Floated ball wide outside off, Wade tries to sweep but fails to middle it.
Flatter and shorter around off, skidding through off the surface, Wade rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Allows the ball to spin back in from outside off and plays it with soft hands to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Fine footwork by Wade! He dances down to the pitch of the delivery and chips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Good calculative risk from the wicketkeeper batsman.
Wade has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy full ball landing around leg, Wade kneels across and paddles it down to fine leg for a couple.
Slower off spinner outside off, a bit on the shorter side, Wade punches from the crease to point.
Finally, Ravichandran Ashwin comes into the attack.
Spinning back into the batsman from outside off, Wade works it off the inner half of the bat to backward square leg for a single.
Around the pads, worked wide of short fine leg for a single.
Whoa! Sharp spin from the rough, breaks away towards off, Smith tries to defend from the crease but is beaten.
Tossed up ball on off, pushed with an angled bat to the off side.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball landing outside leg, Smith offers no shot and takes it on his pads.
Wayward bouncer down the leg side, Wade shapes up for the pull shot but then leaves it.
Angles in a length ball on off, Smith shuffles across the stumps and tickles it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller and angling in on middle, Wade brings his bat and pad together and works it off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball wide outside off, MW allows it through to the keeper.
Full and outside off, trying to lure the batsman into a drive but Wade decides not to fall prey to the plan.
Third man comes in place.
FOUR! Nicely done! Good length delivery outside off, from around the wicket, Wade waits for it calmly inside the crease and at the last moment runs it down to the third man fence.
Fuller and landing outside leg, Smith pads it away to end the over.
Flighted on middle, Smith drives it with the spin towards extra cover. Slight hesitation over a run and they eventually decide not to cross.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it with the spin to deep square leg for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Four byes! Loopy ball landing outside off, on the rough and spins back in sharply, Wade fails to defend and Saha also fails to collect. It speeds behind for a boundary.

Bowls it with a round-arm action, full and skidding in from middle, Smith works it through mid-wicket and takes three runs. Ishant Sharma in the deep was a bit lazy. Also his throw came at the wrong end and Jadeja collected it before missing his shy at the striker's end.
Angles in a length ball on off, from around the wicket, Wade covers the line and defends it to short cover.
Yadav is back over the wicket to Smith and bowls it very full outside off, it's driven with good timing to sweeper cover for a run.
Pitches it full and around off, Wade goes hard at it and pushes it firmly to mid off for a run. Jadeja has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
FOUR! Terrific shot! Yadav overpitches outside off and Wade leans into the cover drive. Lovely transfer of the weight on the front foot and it rockets through the gap for a boundary.
Yadav switches his angle for the left-hander and darts in a full ball on off, Wade covers the line and defends.
Starts with an angled delivery on a length around off, Smith gets across the stumps and tucks it through backward square leg for a run. 350 up for Australia!
Umesh Yadav is back on.
Turning back into the batsman from the rough outside off, Wade gets back and defends it to the off side. Looks for a run but is sent back.
Lunges to a full ball and pushes it in the gap at covers for a run.
Goes slower through the air and bowls it full around off, some extra bounce on this occasion and Smith defends it with a loose bottom hand.
Flatter and around off, Wade goes back and taps it down in front of cover-point for a sharp run.
Tossed up ball on off, Smith quietly drops it in the gap at cover-point and calls his partner for a quick single.
Flighted and full ball on off, Smith lunges and presents a straight bat in defense.
Tidy line from Ishant, serves another full ball around off and Wade is forced to defend it.
Once again probes around the off stump line with a fuller length delivery, Wade defends it to the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish and on middle, staying low, Wade gets behind the line and defends it back.
Full and angling down the leg side, from around the wicket, Wade plays it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off, Smith stands back and steers it through point for a run.
FOUR! Better from Wade this time. Rushes down to the pitch of the delivery and whips it with the spin through mid-wicket for a boundary. Spoils yet another maiden from Jadeja.
Fuller and quicker on off, Wade sticks back, gets squared up and somehow defends it to the off side.
Gets back, covers the line and spin and then punches it back to the bowler.
Once again moves across the stumps and defends it with the spin to short leg.
Flighted ball landing on the rough outside off, Wade gets across the stumps to defend but fails to put bat on ball.
Wade has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drinks break.

FOUR! Horrible piece of fielding and it has gone for a boundary. Full in length and outside off, Smith reaches out for it and pushes it with an angled bat to covers. Yadav moves to his right from cover-point, Pujara rushes across to his left from covers, both collide and the ball sneaks through them for a boundary. Very amateurish stuff.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! Great timing and placement! Lovely wristwork by the Aussie skipper. He receives a fuller length ball around off and clips it through mid-wicket. There is a fielder in the deep but he has no chance of cutting it off.
Smith has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Stifled appeal for a catch! A back of a length delivery outside off, not rising much, Smith gets back and tries to punch but it takes the inside edge and flies behind. Saha tries his best to catch it but it falls just in front of him.
Square leg drops back for Steven Smith.
Ishant runs in from around the wicket for the southpaw and bowls it around middle and leg, Wade nudges it to fine leg for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. A wicket maiden for Jadeja, he is yet to concede a run today. His bowling figures this morning - 4-4-0-1!
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Loopy and landing outside off, Wade tries to sweep but misses. Saha fails to collect it cleanly and it goes over first slip off his pads. A bye taken.
Flatter and landing outside off, spinning in, Wade gets across the stumps and defends it off his pads to the leg side.
Matthew Wade is the new batsman.

OUT! Jadeja strikes! He bowls it in the flatter trajectory around off and it spins away after kissing the turf, Maxwell goes back to punch it through the line but ends up getting a faint outside edge to Saha. He makes no mistake. Catches the ball and appeals. The finger goes up and Maxwell is already walking. End of an extraordinary knock and India will be relieved to break the 191-run stand. Jadeja is all pumped up.
Flighted and full on off, Maxwell defends it back off his front foot.
Smith has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Smith stays back to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Run out chance missed! Spears in a very full ball on middle, Smith flicks it behind square leg and crosses for a run. They want the second run too, it's a non-existent one but the batsmen cross. Ashwin hurls in a throw at the non-striker's end but Ishant is not up to the stumps. Maxwell gets a life. He was not even in the frame. Poor from the bowler and Ashwin is not happy.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Angles in a full ball on off, Glenn gets behind the line and defends it back. That one stayed low.
Serves it full and outside off, Maxwell drives it off his front foot to covers.
Quicker and flatter on off, punched from the back foot to cover.
Appeal for an lbw, turned down. Floated and wide outside off, Smith gets down the track and tries to defend but misses. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. Maybe some inside edge.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and outside off, spinning away, Smith taps it down from the crease to point.
Shortish and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full floated ball on off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Maiden Test hundred for Glenn Maxwell!

FOUR! Flashes and flashes hard! Here it is, possibly the career-defining moment for Glenn Maxwell. He is all pumped up and hugs his skipper. Yadav offers width outside off, Maxwell goes chasing after it, flashes his bat through the line and edges it past the gully fielder for a boundary. Not a convincing way to reach your milestone but Glenn will take it. He has worked really hard in this innings. Curbed his natural stroke play and batted with a lot of maturity. Brilliant from the Victorian!
Good length ball on off, Maxwell gets behind the line and pushes it to mid on.
The field comes up for Maxwell who is on 99.
Short of a length ball on middle, Smith pulls it with a swivel to long leg and takes a single.
Fullish and angling in, Smith moves across the stumps and offers a straight bat in defense.
Lands it full and just outside off, Smith keeps himself inside the crease and pushes it to covers.
Full and shaping into the batsman, Smith leans forward and across to push it towards mid on.
Drags his length short and lands it on off, Glenn goes back and punches it straight to the fielder at extra cover. Stays on 99!
Beaten! Jadeja serves it full and around off, beautiful flight, Maxwell pushes at it from the crease but it spins away a touch to beat the outside edge. Nervy moment for Maxwell.
Fires in another sharp ball on middle, Maxwell keeps it out to mid-wicket.
Full and quicker on middle, 92 kph, Maxwell pushes it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter on off, Maxwell goes on the back foot and punches it to covers. Straight to the fielder.
Flighted full ball on middle, Maxwell defends it back to the bowler.
Yadav bends his back and bowls a short delivery, but it's too wide and Smith drops his wrists to let it go.
Wayward delivery, on a good length and down the leg side, Smith shuffles across and tries to hit it to fine leg but fails to make any connection.
Streaky shot to move to 99! Fuller and around off, Maxwell outside edges his attempted cover drive to third man for a run.

Terrific delivery, a well-directed bouncer, Maxwell tries to sway away from the line and it goes off his right arm to the keeper. Saha collects the ball, appeals but nothing from the bowler and the umpire.
An off pace delivery, full and angling in on middle, Maxwell presents a dead straight bat in defense.
Pitches it up and around off, Maxwell drives it firmly to mid off.
A shade quicker and fuller on middle, 87 kph, Smith offers a textbook forward defense. End of a maiden over.
Bowls it with a round-arm action, full and drifting in around off, Smith lunges and defends.
Fires it in on off, Smith keeps it out to covers.
Gets fuller and lands it on middle, Smith calmly blocks it back.
Loopy full ball on off, Smith lunges and defends it back to the bowler.
A silly point in place now.
Fuller and around off, Smith gets on the front foot and defends it to point.
Spin time! Ravindra Jadeja comes into the attack.

FOUR! Well played! He attempted that shot a couple of deliveries earlier but failed to connect. But not this time. A short ball wide outside off, Maxwell this time does well to loft it over gully for a boundary.
Bowls it full and around off, Maxwell quietly pushes it through the gap at cover-point and scampers back for the second run. These two are lightning between the wickets.
Yadav loses his radar and slips a length ball down the leg side, Maxwell tries his best to heave it over square leg but once again fails to connect. A good take by Saha behind the stumps.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Maxwell tries to slam it over point but fails to connect. Nearly edged it. Maybe, feeling the heat of the 90s!
Presents the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Serves a length ball on the middle stump line, Maxwell stays back and defends it towards mid on.
Angles in a full ball around off, Smith moves across the stumps and defends it back with a straight bat.
Oversteps and bowls a no ball. Full and outside off, Smith gets across and defends it to the off side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Smith gets back and taps it down to covers. Not in the gap.
Full and angling in around off, Smith gets across the stumps a bit and pushes it off his pads to short mid-wicket.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Moves into the 90s! Ishant sends across a full length ball outside off, shaping away a tad, Glenn gets forward and delicately guides it off the outside half of the blade past gully for a boundary.
Oohhh... A well directed bouncer by Yadav, right at the batsman's body, Maxwell once again decides to sway away but it stays low and Glenn awkwardly pulls it through square leg for one.
Digs in a bouncer, Maxwell decides to duck underneath it.

The word from the dressing room on Virat Kohli is that - "There are no serious concerns which will hamper his speedy recovery and he will continue to receive treatment, which will assist him to play the match."
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a length and around middle and off, Maxwell defends it off his back foot.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven off the front foot to covers, nicely timed but straight to the fielder.
Full and outside off, some extra bounce, Smith taps it down to covers and takes a single.
Bouncer around off, Maxwell sways away from the line to end the over.
Excellent delivery, spears in a fuller length ball on off, Maxwell gets forward with a straight bat and defends it back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Smith stands tall and punches it through backward point for a run.
A gully comes into place.

EDGY FOUR! Ishant hurls across a full length delivery outside off, Smith tries driving it through covers but it catches the outside edge and speeds away to the third man fence. Not a convincing start for the Aussie skipper.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A gentle loosener, wide outside off on a length, Smith has an easy leave.
Ishant Sharma to continue from the other end.

FOUR! Cracking shot! Full in length and outside off, there is a little bit on width on offer and Maxwell pounces onto it. He blazes it through point and sends it racing to the deep point fence. 300 up for Australia!
Fractionally short and outside off, Maxwell pushes it without much timing to mid off.
Oohh...this one stays low after landing on a length around off, Maxwell does well to keep it out.
Ups his pace and bangs in a short ball, 143 kph, Maxwell ducks underneath it.
Back of a length ball on off, Maxwell goes on the back foot and plays it down to point.
Change of bats for Glenn Maxwell.

Whoa! It's all happening out there. Yadav angles in a full ball on off, Maxwell offers a straight bat in defense, manages to keep it out but in the process his bat is broken into half. Umesh Yadav smiles and flexes his biceps. Maxwell is all smiles.

It's time to play the game. Ajinkya Rahane is leading the team on the field, no signs of Virat Kohli. Out come the Australian batsmen, Glenn Maxwell and Steven Smith. Umesh Yadav to kickoff proceedings. A slip and short mid-wicket in place. Here we go...

Pitch report - Another batting day awaits Australia, the pitch is still dry and will adhere to batsmen. There are patches, but there is still time before those come into play and spinners will endure another tough day.

It still remains to be seen whether Virat Kohli, who injured himself yesterday, takes the ground. Either ways, the Indian bowlers will have to prepare mentally with or without him. Can the hosts come back harder on day two or will the visitors continue their resistance? We will find out soon...

Hello and welcome to the second day of the third Test between India and Australia. Steven Smith and Glenn Maxwell have been thorns in India's flesh as they have shared a partnership that the hosts have found very hard to break. The home side could feel that the pitch is hardly assisting the bowlers. But it is essential for them to make early breakthroughs, especially of Australian captain who is looking very dangerous.
... DAY 2, SESSION 1...

The Indian bowlers tried hard on a pitch which was not offering much. There was some turn but it was not alarming and the Aussie batsmen negotiated it with confidence. The Indian pacers did get some reverse going as well but failed to pick any wicket in the last session. The morning session tomorrow is very crucial, more for India as they would look to bounce back by picking wickets. For Australia, their plan will be to bat deep and post a big first innings total on the board. Promises to be an entertaining contest. Do join us at 0930 local (0400 GMT) for all the action. Cheers!

Outstanding session for Australia to end an excellent day for them. They scored in excess of 100 runs and didn't lose a single wicket. Steven Smith kept going strong and stroked an impressive century, while his partner, Glenn Maxwell has showed a lot of patience and maturity in his innings so far. The pair is amidst an unbeaten 159-run stand which has put Australia on top. The home team lost intensity in the field and missed their regular skipper Virat Kohli who hurt his right shoulder in the second session and left the field.

Good length ball just outside off, Smith shuffles across the stumps and defends it down safely. Stumps on day 1! The two batsmen walk towards the dressing room and the Australian spectators in the crowd are giving their players a warm applause.
Last ball of the day...
Goes even fuller this time, just outside off, Smith brings his bat and pad together in defense.
Keeps his length full and just around off, Smith moves across the stumps, gets behind the line and offers a dead straight bat in defense.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Maxwell gets forward to defend but it catches the inside edge and rolls to the right side of the mid-wicket fielder. They scamper across for a single.
Full in length and around off, Maxwell drives it on the up but straight to the cover fielder.
Beaten! This one zips off the surface after landing on a length around off, Maxwell tries to play at it with an angled bat but fails to connect. Nearly edged it.
Last over of the day coming up...
Full and wide outside off, Maxwell reaches out for it and chops it down to third man for one.
Another bouncer and this time Maxwell allows it through to the keeper.
Digs in a well-directed bouncer, Maxwell initially shapes up for the pull shot but then decides not to play at it.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Glenn plays across the line with a shuffle and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Straighter in line, Maxwell turns and works it off his pads to short mid-wicket.
Fullish and on off, Maxwell defends it solidly to the off side.
An overpitched ball on middle, Smith plays a nicely timed on drive and Pujara at mid on dives to take the pace off the ball. He goes to retrieve the ball from the deep and they take a couple of runs.
Fuller and outside off, Smith moves across the stumps a bit and then shoulders arms.
Back of a length ball on off, Maxwell taps it down towards point and pinches a single.

FOUR! Poor effort in the deep by KL Rahul! Ishant dishes out a fuller length ball around off, Maxwell slices his square drive through backward point and Rahul in the deep rushes across to his left. A very lazy attempt by him after reaching the ball and it goes through for a boundary.
Pitches it full and outside off, trying to tempt the batsman to go for it, Maxwell though is not interested. Leaves it comfortably.
Lands it on a length and wide outside off, Maxwell offers no shot and allows it through to the keeper.
Ishant Sharma to share the second new ball from the other end. Two slips in place.
Fuller and angling in from around off, Smith sticks back and keeps it out with an angled bat to the off side.
Serves a full ball in the channel outside off, Smith shoulders arms.
Fullish and outside off, Smith strides forward and pushes it to mid off.
Fuller and straighter, Maxwell plays it with a straight bat and pushes it to the right side of the mid on fielder. Ashwin stops it with a slide and they cross for a run. 150-run stand comes up.
We are getting the replays of ball number 81.4 now. And it's showing that the ball brushed Maxwell's gloves on its way to the first slip fielder. No one spotted that and Maxwell got a reprieve then.
Too full in length on off, it's pushed back.
Spears in a fuller length ball on middle, Smith works it through square leg and takes a single.
Second new ball has been taken. Umesh Yadav will continue...
Four byes! Strange line from Ashwin, once again goes down the leg side and Maxwell decides not to flirt with it. Saha fails to collect and it races away to the fence at fine leg.
Tossed up ball outside off, defended by Maxwell.
Tickles it off his pads to backward square leg for a run.
FOUR! Sliding down the leg side, Smith tries to play the paddle sweep but it catches his gloves and runs fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Smith has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated ball on middle, worked towards the backward short leg fielder.
Angles in a full ball on off, Maxwell gets forward and defends it solidly to the off side.
Full and around off, Glenn forces it down the ground but straight to mid off.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and offers a straight bat in defense.
Too full in length and outside off, Maxwell reaches out for it and pushes it towards covers.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and tailing back into the batsman, Smith does well to keep it out towards mid on.
Umesh Yadav is back for another burst. No signs of new ball yet.
Lunges to defend but it takes a soft outside edge and runs to third man for a couple of runs.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Supreme timing and placement. Ashwin gives this one some extra air but lands it too full outside off, Smith presses forward and threads his drive through the gap between cover and mid off for a boundary.

Shout for an lbw! Tossed up ball landing around middle and spinning down, Maxwell fails to connect with his attempted reverse sweep and is hit on the leg. They appeal and the batsmen cross for a leg bye. No review taken. Rightly so, looked like missing leg to the naked eye.
Flighted and on off, defended off the front foot.
Spinning down the leg side, Maxwell tries to flick but misses.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
19th Test century for Steven Smith, 6th against India.

FOUR! Hundred for Steven Smith! What a player! Floated full ball on middle, Smith gets on the front foot and eases it down the ground for a boundary at long on. Raises his bat to the crowd. The captain once again is leading from the front and has played a brilliant knock, so far. Effortless in his approach and it has been a chanceless innings.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side and the mid-wicket fielder dives to stop the ball.
Flatter again, around middle, Smith gets back and defends it to the leg side.
Steven Smith on 99. The field comes up...
Flatter and shorter on off, Maxwell goes deep inside the crease and cuts it through point for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, Smith goes back and hits it with the spin to deep mid-wicket for a run.

Maxwell has hurt himself it seems. Maybe, cramps. Physio comes out.

Offers the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Quicker and fuller on middle, turned to square leg for a run.
Second new ball is available now.
Driven towards the mid on region. No run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Flighted on off, pushed to the off side.

Haha! What happened there? Tossed up ball on middle, Smith gets back to defend but fails to put bat to it. The ball is stuck on the flap of Smith's pad and Saha wants to take it as he thought it came off the inside edge. Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Walks forward a bit and drives a full ball firmly to the cover fielder.

Eyes the yorker but ends up slipping a low full toss on off, Maxwell pushes it to covers.
Floated full ball on off, Glenn leans forward and defends it watchfully.
Loopy full ball on middle, eased down to long leg for a couple of runs.

It's time for some part-time spin of Murali Vijay.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Smith has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fires a fuller ball on leg, Smith defends it from the crease.

Quicker and fuller on the pads, eased through square leg for one.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Dances down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket. A little bit of hesitancy over a run and they eventually decide not to cross.
Loopy full ball around leg, Smith gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.

Fuller in length on middle and leg, Smith works it through square leg and gets off strike. Moves to 95!
Some issue with the ball. The two umpires get together and decide to replace it.
Delivers a full ball outside off, Smith drives it off his front foot to covers.
Umesh Yadav is back on.
Quicker full ball on the pads, 92 kph, Maxwell nudges it to fine leg for a brace.
Maxwell has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Maiden Test fifty for Glenn Maxwell!

Advances down the track and once again pushes it straight to extra cover.

Ashwin throws it full and wide outside off, Maxwell presses forward and drives it through covers for one.
Gets forward and plays it with the spin to mid-wicket.

A touch short and around off, Maxwell goes back and eases it down to long on for another single.
Loopy and on middle, Smith gets behind the line and forces it to long on for a run.

Leans forward to an off spinner landing outside off and defends it off the inner half of the bat.

Goes on the back foot to a shortish ball and turns it through square leg for one.
Flighted ball on middle, Smith leans forward and defends it back.
Shortish and outside off, Maxwell goes deep inside the crease and pushes it wide of backward point. Yadav gives the chase and pulls it back just before the rope. They take three runs.
Once again fires in a quicker on off, fuller in length, Glenn decides to block it from the back foot.
Pushes it quicker through the air, around off, Maxwell goes on the back foot and defends it off the inner half of the bat.
Flatter and quicker on off, Maxwell rocks back and punches it towards cover-point.
Quicker full ball on middle, Maxwell drops it with soft hands in front of square leg and crosses.
Loopy and around off, Maxwell uses his feet again and defends it safely.
Jumps out of the crease and brings his bat and pad together in defense.

Ravichandran Ashwin is back on.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Walks down to the pitch of the delivery and brings his bat and pad together in defense. It pops out in the air but goes safely to the leg side.
Flighted full ball outside off, Maxwell swats it square of the wicket on the off side and takes a single.
Drops it on a fuller length around off, Smith strides forward and pushes it gently to the cover fielder.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller this time, on middle and leg and angling down, Smith opens up in his stance and tries to flick but misses.
Good length ball on off, Smith walks across the stumps and keeps it out on the leg side.

The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy delivery around off, pushed past covers for one.
Around middle and off, defended into the ground.
Flatter through the air around middle, cut off the back foot through point for a single.
FOUR! Clean strike! Jadeja serves a full ball around off, it's in the slot for him, Maxwell clears hi front leg and smacks it down the ground towards long on for a one bounce boundary.
Around off on a length, Smith stays on the back foot in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Punched through the point region off the back foot for a single.

Play and a miss! Starts with a shortish delivery wide outside off, Smith chases it, tries to slap it through point but fails to connect.

We're back for the last session. The men concerned are out in the middle. 30 overs left in the day's play which shows that the overrate of India has been excellent, a rarity these days. Ishant Sharma to kickoff proceedings...
...DAY 1, SESSION 3...

The Indian bowlers tried hard but without much success. They were wayward at times and Steven Smith in particular batted fluently. An injury to Virat Kohli would be concerning for the home team and they will be hoping for their skipper to recover soon and lead them in the field. Do join us in a short while for the last session.

85/1 in 30 overs. That's the story of the afternoon session. Australia will be pleased with the proceedings. They lost Peter Handscomb after a good stand but their skipper Steven Smith has stood like a rock and is nearing yet another century. Glenn Maxwell making a comeback in Test cricket has batted sensibly so far and is turning out to be a perfect foil for the Aussie skipper.
Ends the session with another full delivery, Maxwell jams it out towards the off side. And that will be Tea.
Full delivery and on sticks, Maxwell defends it.
Floats this one on leg, Maxwell has decided to offer no shot.
Tosses this one around leg, Maxwell pads it away.
He is trying to bring this back in from the leg side, but it goes to Saha as he collects it.
Jadeja goes over the wicket and bowls it down the leg side. Maxwell leaves it alone.

Length ball, which comes back in, Smith bunts it back to the bowler.
Very full and on middle, Smith jams it out towards silly mid off.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Smith mistimes his punch towards the off side.
Full and around middle, Smith moves a bit and defends it towards mid-wicket.

50-run stand between Maxwell and Smith.

Bowls it slower through the air and outside off, Smith walks down the pitch and knocks it through mid off for a single. Completes 5000 Test runs with that shot. Becomes the third fastest Australian to reach that feat.
Sanjay Manjrekar on air informs that since it was a no ball, India have not lost the review. Fair enough.

Shortish delivery around off, Smith watchfully dead-bats it.

On a length and outside off, Maxwell steers it down to third man for one run.

However, going to the ball, it would have stayed not out as it was clipping the leg stump.
Huge shout for an lbw. The umpire shakes his head and India take the review.
Ishant Sharma is back on. A couple of slip fielders in place.

Direct hit at the bowler's end. There is an appeal for a run out and it's referred upstairs...

Smith eases this delivery through mid off. One run taken.

Flights this delivery around off, Smith has defended it very well.
Tossed up outside off, Maxwell drives it towards covers, where Rahul makes a sharp stop. One run taken.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floats this one outside off, Smith gets forward and pushes it towards extra cover.
Tosses this one outside off, Smith looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and goes towards point.

Flatter and quicker, flicked through mid-wicket for one run.
Short and around off, Maxwell punches it through mid on. One run taken.
Bowls it slower through the air and around off, Smith blocks it.
Bowls this slightly short and around off, Maxwell punches it towards covers for one run.
Darts this very full and outside off, Smith creams it through covers for one run.
