Floats this one outside off, Maxwell prods forward and pushes it towards the off side.
Tosses this one around off, Maxwell strides forward and defends.
Very full and on the sticks, Maxwell jams it back to the bowler.
Bowls a full toss and outside off, Smith pushes it to covers.
Length delivery, Smith stonewalls it offering the full face of the bat.
Full length delivery outside off, Smith pushes it towards the off side.
Fuller length ball, Smith flicks it to mid-wicket.
Yorker! Smith digs it out very well. Even he appreciates Umesh's effort delivery.
Leg bye! Length ball, around leg, Maxwell looks to clip but it hits his pad and goes towards the leg side. Leg bye taken!
Smith shuffles across and pats this floated delivery towards the leg side.
Smith shows the full face of the bat and defends the tossed up ball off the back foot.

Huge appeal for an LBW! Turned down. Floats this one around middle and leg, Maxwell goes back to tuck it away but misses and the ball hits his pads. Rahane ponders over a review for a bit but opts against it. Replays show it was missing leg. They run a leg bye.
Very full and on sticks, Maxwell flicks it towards the leg side.
Floats this one around off and middle, Maxwell strides forward and blocks it with an angled bat.
Tosses this one around off, Maxwell pushes it towards the off side.
Leg bye. On a length, around middle and leg, Maxwell goes across looking to flick but he misses and it raps the pads. Umesh Yadav goes up, but the umpire is not interested. They run a leg bye.
Fuller length delivery, around middle and leg, Maxwell drives it down the ground.
Good length delivery, outside off, Maxwell guides it down to third man. One run taken.
Length ball around off, Maxwell tucks it through square leg for one run.
Sticks to the fuller length, brings this back in, Maxwell gets across and blocks it with straight face of the bat.
Full and on the sticks, Maxwell knocks it to mid on.
Full delivery and around off, Smith goes back and stonewalls it.
Shorter and flatter, Smith rocks back to defend but it goes off the outside edge of his bat towards point. The batsmen run through for a brace.
Looped up delivery around off, Smith blocks it.
Floats this one outside off, Smith is rock solid in defense.
Gives this delivery a lot of flight, Maxwell reaches out to the ball and bunts it down to long on for a single.
Tosses this on the sticks, Maxwell goes forward and offers a front foot defense.
Time for drinks. An even-steven session as Umesh Yadav snared the wicket of Handscomb.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Umesh and Smith punishes him. Full and on the pads, Smith shuffles across and tickles it very fine. No deep fine leg in the world could've stopped it.
Very full and outside off, Maxwell opens the face of the bat and caresses it through point for one run.
Reverse swing! Fuller delivery, which swings in sharply, Smith gets across and flicks it to deep mid-wicket. One run added to the total!
Length ball, outside off, Maxwell pushes it to left of cover fielder for one run.
Beautiful shot for no run! Full and angling in, Maxwell drives it down the ground. But Umesh gets his hand to it in his followthrough.
Strays this on the pads, Smith tucks it to fine leg. One run added to the total.
Bowls this a lot faster, Smith stays back and flicks it to deep mid-wicket. Single taken.
Bowls this very full and on the sticks, Smith digs it out towards the leg side.
Maxwell knocks this tossed up delivery through mid on for one run. Gets off the mark with that shot.
Bowls this very full, Maxwell drives it back to the bowler.
Tosses this one around off, Maxwell goes forward and dead-bats it with an angled bat.
Loopy off spinner on off, Smith gets back and turns it behind square leg for a run.
Ravichandran Ashwin comes back into the attack. A slip and silly mid on has been deployed.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length ball on off, Maxwell defends it off his back foot.
Yadav goes short this time with his length, around off, Glenn sways away from the line.
Fuller in length and outside off, Maxwell goes hard at it first up and pushes it firmly to covers.
Glenn Maxwell strides out in the middle to replace Peter Handscomb.

OUT! Handscomb is given lbw! A cracking delivery by Yadav, a toe crusher at 140 kph, Handscomb is beaten for pace and is late in bringing his bat down. It hits him flush on the left boot, they appeal and the finger goes up almost immediately. Peter decides not to review it after consulting his skipper and India finally manage to break the partnership. The replays show that it hit the batsman in line and was crashing on the leg stump.
Steven Smith brings up his 21st Test fifty. It is his fourth versus India.

Fifty for Smith! He keeps on piling runs against India. Fuller in length on middle and leg, Smith moves across the stumps and flicks it through backward square leg for a run. Vital knock this by the Aussie skipper.
Flighted and full around off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
50-run stand comes up between Smith and Handscomb!
Walks down the track and knocks it down to long on for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it safely.
Bowls it slower and outside off, Smith pushes it towards off side.
Loops this one outside off, Handscomb drills it through covers for one run.
Virat Kohli is receiving some ice treatment on his right shoulder. Hopefully, he is fine.
Length ball, nips back in, Smith flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Bangs this short and outside off, Peter guides it behind point for one run.
Fullish delivery, outside off, Handscomb drives it with an angled bat towards covers.
Good delivery, which comes back in, Handscomb shuffles across and blocks it with the straight face of the bat.
FOUR! Classy shot from Peter Handscomb. Back of a length delivery again, outside off, PH waits for the ball and cuts it very late through point for a boundary.
Short of a length delivery, around off, Handscomb gets on his toes and defends it.
Umesh Yadav replaces Ishant in the attack.
Bowls this delivery on the stumps, Smith knocks it back to the bowler.
Floats this one around off, Smith drives it to the cover fielder.
Fuller delivery and on the stumps, Smith clears his front leg and drives it to silly mid off.
Tossed up around off, Smith goes forward and stonewalls it.
Gives this delivery a lot of flight, outside off, Smith drives it to covers.

Physio comes out. Virat Kohli is looking in some discomfort. Stretching his right arm. In fact, the Indian skipper is walking off the field. Abhinav Mukund is the substitute fielder. Ajinkya Rahane will be leading in Kohli's absence.

Tosses this one on middle and leg, Handscomb dances down the track and flicks it between mid-wicket and mid off. Virat Kohli, at mid-wicket chases it and stops it very close to the boundary. Jeez, he has saved one run for his team but he seems to have hurt his right shoulder. The last thing India would want right now is an injury to the captain. Three runs taken.
FOUR! On a length, slightly outside off, Smith deliberately opens the face of the bat and guides it past the point region for the boundary. That area was vacant and he gets his reward.
Bowls this very full and on the sticks, Smith gets his bat down and jams it out towards the bowler.
Good length delivery around off, Smith opens the face of the bat and buries it onto the ground.
Sticks to full length, outside off, Smith drives it towards the cover fielder who makes a good stop.
Full delivery outside off, Smith leans forward and pushes it towards the cover region.
Back of a length delivery, around off, Smith goes back and blocks it.
Handscomb tries to reach to the pitch of this looped up delivery but it takes the inside edge and goes onto rap the pads. India appeal but the umpire has turned it down.
Tossed up around off, PH drives it to mid off.
Handscomb uses his feet to this floated delivery and defends it.
Handscomb has defended this off the back foot.
Smith creams this tossed up delivery through covers for a single.
Close? Not actually. Bowls this a lot flatter and quicker, Smith goes back to flick but it goes off the inside edge onto his pad. Jadeja appeals but realises that it came off the bat.
Silly mid off in place for a mistimed drive.
Lands this on a length on off, Handscomb pushes it towards the off side.
Bowls another full delivery, outside off, Handscomb defends it back towards the bowler.
Bowls the full delivery again, outside off, Handscomb defends it towards covers.
Full delivery, around middle and leg, Smith goes across and flicks it through mid-wicket. Single taken.
Fuller length delivery, swinging in, Smith gets across and defends it.
On a length, way outside off, Smith has no reason to play at it.
Smith eases this floated delivery to long off and runs one to retain the strike.
Bowls it slower through the air and around off, Smith has buried it onto the pitch.
Drags his length back to this one, Smith goes back and blocks it.
Loops this one outside off, Smith knocks it to mid off.
Smith goes ahead and blocks this delivery.
FOUR! First boundary of the session! Tossed up outside off, Smith gets forward and drives it elegantly through covers. The outfield does the rest.
Misfield from Murali Vijay and Kohli is not impressed. Full length ball outside off, Peter strides forward and pushes it past the tumbling point fielder. Two runs taken.
Lands this on a length, fourth stump line, PH is rock solid in defense.
Fuller and on off, Handscomb knows that it's reversing, he leans forward and blocks it.
Bowls this on a full length, comes back in, Handscomb prods and defends it.
The second slip fielder is standing a couple of steps ahead than the normal position. Maybe, to counter the lack of bounce.
Angles in a fuller length delivery, Handscomb defends it off the outside half of his bat towards point.
Good length delivery around off, the bounce is low but Handscomb reads it early and defends it towards the off side.
Bowls this delivery on off, Smith prods forward and blocks it.
Handscomb gets to the pitch of the ball and flicks it through fine leg for one run.
Bowls it slower through the air, outside off, Handscomb dead-bats it.
Handscomb uses his feet to this floated delivery and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Bowls this a lot fuller and on the sticks, Handscomb defends it towards the leg side.
Tosses this one on the pad, Smith uses his feet and flicks it off the inside half of his bat towards long leg. Single taken.
Angles in a fuller delivery, on the sticks, Handscomb is rock solid in defense.
Good ball! Length ball, around off, Handscomb leans forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. Close shave, that!
Bowls this marginally ahead of length, outside off, tapped to point.
Two Leg byes! Sprays this down the leg side, PH looks to tickle it but it hits his pad and goes towards fine leg. They run two leg byes.
Bangs this short again, Handscomb stays in his crease and buries it onto the ground.
Back of a length delivery which nips back in, Smith gently pats it towards point and runs one.

Run out chance missed? Jadeja fires in a fuller length ball on middle, Smith comes down the track and bunts it to mid on for a quick single. Vijay attacks the ball but fails to collect it cleanly which allowed Smith to make it safely.
Drops it flat and short on off, Smith punches it from the back foot but finds the cover fielder again.
Tossed up ball on off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Too full in length on off, Smith digs it out straight to short extra cover.
Short extra cover in place for Smith.
Flighted this time, full and around middle, Handscomb eases it through square leg and takes a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, Peter gets back and punches it straight to mid off.
Ravindra Jadeja to continue from the other end.
On a length, slightly outside off, Smith moves across and blocks it on the up.
Full length ball, in the line of the fourth stump, it stays a bit low. Smith dead-bats it carefully.
Shortish delivery, which bounces a bit more, Smith hops and blocks it.
Bowls a full delivery on off, Smith moves slightly and defends it.
Angles in short of a length delivery, which comes back in, Smith shuffles across a touch and knocks it back to the bowler.
Starts the session with a back of a length ball around off, Smith gets on his toes and punches it unconvincingly towards the off side.

The Indian players are sauntering out in the middle. Australian captain Steven Smith and Peter Handscomb are at the crease. Will Virat Kohli continue with spin? No! Ishant Sharma is brought back into the attack.
... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

The now infamous pair of Steven Smith and Peter Handscomb are at the crease and they have a massive session waiting for them. It will be vital for the visitors to take advantage of the toss factor and not allow India any more opening. Join us in a bit for the post-lunch session.

Matt Renshaw and Steven Smith held their own. But a rare lapse of concentration ensured that Umesh Yadav saw the back of the southpaw. Surprisingly, India were brilliant with DRS in the first session. They first decided to not take a review of an LBW early on and opted for one immediately of a bat-pad catch of Shaun Marsh, which ended up being successful.

Beating all the rumors and bets, Ranchi has presented the best first session batting deck of the series, however it is India who have edged Australia, ever so slightly. The tourists got a brilliant start as they scored freely, the quick outfield did help. But the introduction of spin put brakes on their scoring rate and David Warner played a loose shot to get out.
Tossed up ball on off, Handscomb stretches forward and defends it watchfully. Lunch on day 1!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pushes it flatter and quicker on middle, skidding in, Smith tries to defend it by lunging but it goes off the inside edge to mid-wicket. They cross for a run.
Flighted full ball on middle, Smith gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
Flatter arm ball landing on middle, Smith gets back and eases it to long leg for a couple of runs.
Loopy and full around leg, Smith works it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Hurls in a length delivery in the zone outside off, holding its line, Peter covers the line and shoulders arms.
Fuller and on off, Peter gets behind the line and defends it from the crease.
Angling down the leg side, Smith tries flicking but misses. It goes off his pads to backward square leg and they cross for a leg bye.
FOUR! Superb timing! Yadav is too straight in his line again, it's fuller in length and Smith flicks it with good timing timing through square leg for a boundary.

LUCKY FOUR! Yadav spears in a fuller length ball on middle and leg, Smith tries to flick but it catches the inside edge and runs through his legs to the fine leg fence. We have seen Smith hit those flicks through his legs in the past but this one was not deliberate.
Fullish and outside off, Smith gets forward and pushes it to mid off.
Fuller and on middle, Smith walked down the track and forced it through mid on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy and full on off, it's pushed off the front foot to covers.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Smith defends it off his front foot.
Arm ball on middle, skidding in, Smith gets back and defends it to short leg.
Flighted full ball on middle, Smith gets on the front foot and defends it to the leg side.
Ravindra Jadeja is brought back into the attack.
Lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Full and straight, angling in, it's flicked firmly on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Lands it on a fuller length just around off, Handscomb defends it by getting forward.
Fuller in length and targeting the middle stump line, Peter gets behind the line and defends it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Huge shout for an lbw! Yadav bowls a full delivery on middle and leg, angling down, Handscomb fails to flick and is rapped on the pads. They appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. No DRS taken and the replays show that it would have missed the leg stump.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Steps down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Handscomb has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark! Flighted full ball around off, Peter gets forward with a big stretch and drives it superbly through extra cover for a boundary.
Peter Handscomb is the new man in.

OUT! Good review from India! Ashwin strikes and Australia are three down now. A flighted ball on middle, skidding down, Marsh gets forward with his bat and pad together in defense. He fails to keep it out and the ball pops out off his pads to short leg. Pujara reacts quickly to his left and takes the ball with a dive. They appeal vociferously but the umpire remains unmoved. The Indians are quite sure, Virat Kohli goes for the DRS and the replays confirm that there was a faint inside edge onto the pads. Brilliant catch too. Marsh probably was playing for the turn which was not there. Got deceived and hence is out of here.
Huge shout for a bat-pad catch! The umpire remains unmoved and India have taken the review.
Good length ball on off, Smith eases himself on the back foot and punches it square of the wicket on the off side. Finds backward point.
Fuller in length and swinging in, Smith works it off his pads to the leg side. Straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
A silly mid on is in place.
On a length and outside off, Marsh taps it down from the crease to cover-point for a run.
Edged but safe! Angles in a length ball on off, Marsh stays back to push inside the line but edges it behind. It goes on one bounce to Kohli at first slip.
Tempting line by Yadav, serves it on a driving length outside off, Marsh decides to let it through to the keeper.
Steams in from around the wicket and angles in a length ball on off, Marsh defends it by getting forward.
Full and on middle, pushed straight to mid off.

Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and once again drills it back past the bowler. Ashwin could have done better there to stop the ball in his followthrough. It races through and Vijay moves swiftly across to his left from long on to prevent the ball from touching the rope. A couple of runs taken.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Turning the other way, probably a carrom ball, Marsh fails to work it around and it goes off his pads to square leg. A leg bye taken.
Once again good flight by Ashwin as he delivers it from around the wicket to Marsh, landing on middle and off and it's defended back.
Nicely tossed up ball on off, fuller in length, Smith gets forward and pushes it back past the bowler to mid on for a run.
Full and angling in, staying a bit low as well, Smith plays it off his pads to mid-wicket for a run.
Angles it on middle and leg, Smith gets across the stumps and helps it to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Gets forward and pushes it with soft hands on the off side. It rolls in the gap and Marsh gets off the mark with a single.
Shaun Marsh strolls out in the middle.

OUT! Edged and gone this time! Umesh Yadav hurls across a back of a length ball just outside off, straightening a touch, Renshaw pushes inside the line without any footwork and outside edges it to first slip. A good low catch by Virat Kohli and it brings an end to a promising knock by Renshaw. Smith is not looking pleased with the shot that Matt attempted. A ball prior to this also he was trying to run it down to third man with a couple of slips in place. Very risky attempt and he has paid a big price for it.
Edged but safe! On a good length again, outside off, Renshaw opens the face of the bat to run it down to third man but ends up dabbing it in front of Rahane at second slip.
Good length ball on off, Renshaw stands back and helps it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Flighted and around off, Smith sticks back and offers a straight bat in defense.
Slower off spinner on off, Smith gets back and defends it to the leg side.
Spinning away slightly, Renshaw plays it with an angled bat and guides it past backward point. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Uppish but safe! Nicely tossed up ball on off, too full in length, Renshaw is early into the shot and ends up pushing it back uppishly. Doesn't carry to Ashwin.
Leans forward and defends it near his front pad.
Loopy off spinner on off, Renshaw gets on the front foot and defends it back.
Change of ends for Ravichandran Ashwin.
Around off, Smith gets across the stumps and defends it towards silly mid on.
A silly mid on for Smith has been deployed.
Switches to over the wicket and spears in a fuller length ball on off, Smith defends it off his pads to short mid-wicket.
Full in length and wide outside off, Renshaw reaches out for it and drives it square of the wicket on the off side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Runs in from around the wicket and darts it in around off, Matt blocks it off his back foot.
On a length and around off, Renshaw stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to cover-point.
Full and angling in around off, Renshaw gets forward in defense.
Now Virat Kohli brings back Umesh Yadav. Think he wanted him to bowl from the other end. He will replace Ashwin. Two slips in place.
Smith has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy and outside off, driven off the front foot back to the bowler.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Loopy and on middle, Renshaw eases it through backward square leg for one.
Full and on middle, pushed down to mid on.

Appeal for a catch! Tossed up ball landing around off, spinning in, Renshaw walks forward with the flick shot but misses and is hit on the pads. It lobs up to Rahane at first slip who collects the ball. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. The replays confirm that there was no inside edge and the impact was also outside off.
Umesh Yadav comes back into the attack. Hold on, Kohli has a change of minds. Jadeja will continue.
Full flighted outside off, Smith tries to drive it through covers but it catches the outside half of the bat and runs wide of backward point. Two runs added to the total.
Shortish on off, punched off the back foot but straight to silly mid on.
Gets forward to a full ball and drives it through the line. Finds the gap at extra cover and picks up a single.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it to silly mid off.
Flattish and around off, Renshaw punches it from the crease to covers.
A silly mid off is in place.
Goes slower through the air, full and on off, Smith gets forward and defends it to the off side.
Fires in a quicker full ball on off, Renshaw knocks it down to long on for one.
Floated full ball landing around off and spinning in, Matt gets forward and defends it back.
Fullish around off, Smith skips down the track and pushes it towards covers for a single.
Loopy full ball on off, drifting in and spinning away a touch, Smith lunges and defends it from the upper half of the bat to the off side.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning in, Renshaw gets forward and drives it down to long on. There is a fielder in the deep and they take a single.
Loopy off spinner on middle, Smith quietly plays it off his pads to short mid-wicket.
Turns it off his pads through mid-wicket and collects a single.
Flighted and full outside off, it's driven off the front foot to point.
Renshaw has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, Renshaw drives it back past the bowler to mid on.
Flattish and on middle, Matt gets back and defends it off his pads to the leg side.
Smith has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Excellent footwork on this occasion. Gets to the pitch of the ball around leg and whips it through mid-wicket. Ashwin chases it from mid on but the ball wins the race. Don't want to keep repeating but this outfield is veryyy quick.
Loopy and full this time, Smith plays a flowing drive but finds the cover fielder.
Shortish and outside off, Smith stands tall and punches it square of the wicket on the off side. Finds point.
Arm ball this time, full and on middle, it's defended off the inner half of the bat to the leg side.
Full flighted ball on middle, Smith gets forward and defends it with a straight bat.

Drinks have been called. Australia started well as Matt Renshaw scored rapidly, thanks to the quick outfield. But the introduction of spin brought the wicket of David Warner and since then Australia's scoring rate has been slow.
A touch shorter and around off, Smith uses the crease well and punches it to long on for a run.
Once again it's nicely flighted, full and around off, Smith remains back and offers a straight bat in defense.
Flighted full on off, Renshaw drives it past the diving bowler to long off for a run.
Spinning back in from around off, Smith goes back and helps it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flights it in the air and serves it full outside off, Smith comes down the track and pushes it to covers.
Loopy off spinner on off, Smith defends it by getting behind the line.
Full floated on off, Renshaw lunges and defends it on the leg side.
Advances down the track to reach the pitch of the delivery, tries to flick it through mid-wicket but it comes off the inside edge and runs towards backward square leg for a run.
This one is very full and around off, Smith drives it straight to mid off.
Goes flatter and on off, pushing the batsman back, Smith does back to block it from the crease.
Loopy and full on off, Smith draws forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball on middle, Smith gets forward with a straight bat and defends it off the inside half to mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter on off, Smith gets back and punches it past the bowler for a run at long on.
A nicely tossed up delivery around off, full and spinning in, Smith is forward in defense.
Walks down to the pitch of the delivery and pushes it back to the bowler.
Too full and on middle, drifting in, Matt bunts it down through mid off for a run.

FOUR! Excellent shot! Renshaw is looking in great touch. Flighted full ball around off, spinning away a touch, Renshaw gets on the front foot and strokes it sweetly through extra cover for a boundary.
Loopy and on middle, Renshaw gets back and turns it off his pads to short leg.
Fires in a quicker delivery, around off, 93 kph, Smith defends it off his back foot.
Gets forward to a full ball and defends it watchfully.
Flighted and around off, not bouncing much, Smith mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! An arm ball on middle, skidding down, Smith picks it off his pads and deflects it fine down the leg side for a boundary. The Aussie skipper is off the mark.
Flighted ball on middle, too full in length, Smith gets behind the line and forces it down to mid on.
Leans forward to a full ball around off and defends it off the inner half of the bat to the leg side.
Nicely flighted delivery, full and on middle, Renshaw flicks it off his pads to short mid-wicket.
Too full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Slower this time, full and drifting in around off, Matt defends it from the crease.
Goes quicker and flatter around off, Renshaw immediately goes on the back foot in defense.
Loopy full ball around off, Renshaw lunges and defends it on the leg side.
Loopy and fuller around off, Smith once again gets forward to defend it on the off side. End of a successful over for India!
Flighted ball around off, Smith defends it near his front pad.
Australian skipper Steven Smith arrives at the crease to replace David Warner.

OUT! A real soft dismissal for Warner! Jadeja lets out a low full toss this time, Warner could have hit it anywhere in the field but ends up smashing it straight back. It's uppish and Jadeja shows great reflexes to catch it to his left. That was travelling. Brilliant from Jadeja. Australia lose their first wicket after a brisk start. A dejected Warner walks back to the pavilion.
FOUR! Nicely floated delivery, full and outside off, Warner reaches out for it and drills it through covers for a boundary. 50 up for Australia in no time.
Too full on this occasion, around off, Renshaw drives it through covers and takes a single.
Tossed up ball on off, defended back to the bowler off the front foot.
Ravindra Jadeja comes into the attack. Slip, leg gully and a short leg have been positioned.
Full around off, Matt drives it to short extra cover where Kohli parries it towards mid off. A run taken.
Goes flatter and shorter on off, Renshaw gets back and punches it back to the bowler.
Loopy and outside off, spinning away, left alone by Renshaw.
Once again pitches it fuller and around off, Renshaw defends it in front of his front pad.
Floated full ball on off, Matt gets on the front foot in defense.
In the air... Flighted ball landing around leg, Renshaw tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It takes the leading edge and goes uppishly past silly point.
Lands it full and around off, Warner gets forward and pushes it with an angled bat to point. A little bit of unsure footwork there.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! Not a single muscle moved in the field! Full in length and outside off, Warner gets on the front foot and drives it with all the elegance through extra cover. First boundary from the bat of David. Completes 1000 Test runs against India!
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
First running run for Renshaw! Straighter in line, Matt flicks it through mid-wicket and now there is a fielder in the deep. Still a couple of runs taken.
Fuller and on middle, Warner turns it off his pads to wide mid on and crosses for a run.

FOUR! Sixth boundary for Renshaw! What did he have for breakfast? Flighted ball on middle, Renshaw gets forward with a big stretch and flicks it elegantly through mid-wicket. The outfield does the rest. It's been a cracking start for Australia! Ravi Shastri on air informs that Matt Renshaw has become the youngest to reach 500 Test runs. Wow!
Goes flatter and shorter around off, staying a bit low, Warner goes deep inside the crease and cuts it through cover-point for a run.
Fuller and on off, Warner draws forward and pushes it back. Ashwin runs across to his right to stop the ball.
Slight delay as David Warner seems to have some issues with the sightscreen.
Floated full around off, Warner presses forward and defends it to the off side.
Lovely delivery, gives it the extra flight and lands it on a full length just outside off. Warner leaves it as the ball spins away with good bounce.
Flighted full ball outside off, Warner goes hard at it and drills it through the line. It hits the silly point fielder and rests near the surface.

After six overs of pace, India introduce spin. It's Ravichandran Ashwin to go first up. He has dismissed Warner thrice in this Test series, so far and would like to make it four. A slip and silly point in place.
That's a sharp delivery. Bowled on a length at 148 kph, Renshaw sits back in defense.
FOUR! Glorious! Fifth boundary for Renshaw. He is yet to run for his runs. An overpitched delivery around off, Matt leans stylishly into his drive and creams it through covers for a boundary.
Fuller in length and down the leg side, Warner fails to flick this time and it goes off his pads to backward square leg. A leg bye taken again.
A rising delivery around leg, Renshaw once again tries to glance but misses. It goes off his thigh pad to short fine leg and they collect a leg bye.
Good length delivery angling down the leg side, Renshaw tries to glance but misses. That was not very far from his gloves.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Warner jumps on the back foot and turns it in front of square leg. Pujara chases it and the batsmen collect three runs.
Angles across a length delivery around off, Renshaw gets across the stumps a bit and dabs it down in front of the gully fielder.

FOUR! Renshaw is dealing in boundaries! Wrong line from Ishant, strays on the pads and Matt just tickles it through backward square leg for a boundary. He is not trying to hit it hard and is relying on his timing. A stare from Ishant!
Goes very full this time with his length, around off and Warner drives it straight this time. The mid off fielder moves across to his left to stop the ball and they cross for a single.
Lands it full and just around off, Warner draws forward and defends it to the off side.

Pitches it full and just outside off, Warner gets forward and drives it to mid off. Straight to the fielder. This is looking a good pitch for batting. But we cannot judge it too soon. Let the spinners bowl on it.
On a length and angling down the leg side, Warner nudges it off his pads to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Lovely hands of Renshaw! A touch short in length and just outside off, Renshaw stays back and just opens the face of the bat at the last moment. Utilizes the pace of the bowler and runs it down to third man for a boundary.

Yadav attempts for a yorker maybe but ends up serving a full toss around off, Renshaw punches it down the ground and Ashwin moves across to his left from mid off to make a diving stop. Good energy in the field shown by India, so far!
Fuller length ball around off, angling away, Warner plays it with soft hands and quietly pushes it in front of mid off. Straightaway calls his partner through for a single and completes it with ease.
Goes full on this occasion, in the line of the stumps, Warner prefers to stay back footed in defense.
Back of a length delivery on off, Warner goes on the back foot and punches it straight to the cover fielder.
Identical to the last delivery, Renshaw comes up with another nicely timed flick shot but this time he finds the mid-wicket fielder.

FOUR! Shot! Once again just the touch of the bat and it races through the fence. Fuller in length and around off, Renshaw gets forward with a big stride and flicks it sweetly through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Renshaw has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Huge shout for an lbw! Ishant lands it on a good length and it skids through to strike Renshaw on the pads as he fails to defend. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The Indian skipper has a chat with his keeper, Ishant is not sure about the pitching and eventually they decide not to review it. Great call, the replays show that it pitched outside leg.
Beaten this time! Full in length and angling away from the batsman, Renshaw without any footwork has a nervous push inside the line and misses.
Fuller length ball on off, good line from Ishant, Renshaw offers a straight bat in defense.
Back of a length delivery on off, Warner defends it with a jump to the off side.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shortish and in the line of the stumps, Warner defends it from the back foot.

Stifled appeal for a caught behind! Nothing from the umpire. A delivery down the leg side, on a length, Warner tries to flick but fails to middle. There is some noise as it goes to Saha. He collects it with a dive to his right and they appeal but the umpire remains unmoved. Maybe, the sound was of the ball clipping the thigh pad.

Wow, big bounce on this occasion. Yadav lands it on a length around off and it kicks off the surface, Warner leaves it alone and Saha collects it over his head. Hmm...we already can see some variable bounce on this pitch.
Good length ball on middle, Warner glances it off his hips through backward square leg for a couple of runs. Both the Aussie openers are off the mark.
Umesh Yadav to share the new cherry from the other end. Two slips in place.

FOUR! Great timing and the outfield looks lightning quick. It's a full length ball around middle and leg, Renshaw just flicks it with a shuffle and times it supremely. It races through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Better line and length this time by Ishant, keeps it around off on a good length, Renshaw defends it off his back foot.
First delivery that Renshaw is forced to play. It's full and around off, Matt halfheartedly plays at it and keeps it out with an angled bat to the off side.
The line stays outside the off stump but this time the length is a driving one. Not much bounce or movement, Renshaw allows it through.
Another delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, too wide to make the batsman play. An easy leave for Matt.
Starts with a full length ball outside off, angling away from the batsman, not much bounce, Renshaw allows it through to the keeper.
Ishant Sharma takes the new ball. Two slips, gully and a short leg has been deployed.

Right then, Virat Kohli is leading his men onto the ground. They are in a huddle, some inspiring words by the skipper before they take their respective positions. David Warner and Matt Renshaw too have arrived at the crease.
Time for the national anthem. The players from both teams are out in the centre. This is Australia's 800th Test and they will be looking to make it a memorable one.
India - Lokesh Rahul, Murali Vijay, Cheteshwar Pujara, Virat Kohli(c), Ajinkya Rahane, Karun Nair, Wriddhiman Saha(w), Ravichandran Ashwin, Ravindra Jadeja, Umesh Yadav, Ishant Sharma.
Australia - David Warner, Matt Renshaw, Steven Smith(c), Shaun Marsh, Peter Handscomb, Glenn Maxwell, Matthew Wade(w), Pat Cummins, Steve O'Keefe, Nathan Lyon, Josh Hazlewood.

Virat Kohli says that they have lost the toss in the last couple of series but ended up winning those games. Feels it's a challenge once you lose the toss and informs that they also wanted to bat first. Adds they have prepared well and everyone is ready to go. Praises his boys for the performance in Bangalore and wants to capitalize on it. Also adds that the preparation has been good. Informs about the one change, Murali Vijay returns in place of Abhinav Mukund.

Steven Smith says that he doesn't think there will be much bounce and the pitch will take more spin as the game goes on. He hopes to post a good first innings total. Informs that they have prepared well for this game and it was nice to get some rest in between. Confirms that they have two changes - Glenn Maxwell and Pat Cummins replace Mitchell Marsh and Mitchell Starc.
Toss - Up goes the coin, Steven Smith calls it correctly and wins an important toss for his team. No surprises, Australia have elected to bat!

Thankfully, all the off field drama can be put to rest as we are all set to get underway once again. Both sides are on equal terms as far as this series is concerned and there is plenty to play for. We are expecting a cracking contest at this new Test venue in Ranchi. Stay with us for all the updates...

Hello and welcome to the first day of the third Test between India and Australia in Ranchi. A gripping contest between both the sides ended just a few days ago in Bengaluru, but the intensity hasn't died since. There have been endless debates about Virat Kohli's allegations and Steve Smith's 'brain fade' moment. If that was not enough, Ranchi's pitch became a topic of discussion days before the match even started.
